name: Mythic Juvenile Havoc Dragon
body:
MYTHIC JUVENILE HAVOC DRAGON
CR 16/MR 6

This iridescent dragon has glittering wings, a long tail, and a rainbow, joyous aura all around its body.

XP 76,800
CG Large dragon (chaotic, extraplanar, good, mythic)
Init +14; Senses dragon senses; Perception +22
Aura frightful presence (120 ft., DC 23)

DEFENSE

AC 35, touch 13, flat-footed 31 (+4 Dex, +22 natural, –1 size)
hp 228 (16d12+64+60)
Fort +14, Ref +16, Will +13
Defensive Abilities aerobatics, draconic fortitude, uncanny dodge; DR 10/epic; Immune confused, nauseated, paralysis, sickened, sleep, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 220 ft. (average)
Melee bite +23 (2d6+10), 2 claws +23 (1d8+7), tail slap +23 (1d8+10/19–20, plus grab or trip), 2 wings +21 (1d6+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite and tail slap)
Special Attacks bardic performance 13 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate [DC 23], inspire competence +2, inspire courage +1), breath weapon (40-ft. cone, 8d10 sonic damage, Reflex DC 22 half ), grappling tail, lashing tail, lingering breath (2d6 sonic, 6 rounds), mythic power 15/day, surge +1d8
Oracle Spells Known (CL 3rd; concentration +8)

1st (7/day)—detect evil, entropic shield, grease (DC 16)
0th (at will)—create water, detect magic, light, mage hand, open/close

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 18, Con 19, Int 18, Wis 17, Cha 20
Base Atk +16; CMB +23; CMD 37 (41 vs. trip)
Feats Critical Focus, Improved Critical (tail slap), Improved FlightM, Improved InitiativeM, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Weapon FocusM (tail slap), Wingover
Skills Bluff +24, Fly +21, Knowledge (local, planes) +23, Perception +22, Perform (comedy, sing) +24, Sense Motive +22, Spellcraft +23, Use Magic Device +24
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Sylvan
SQ aura of joy, change shape (3/day), planar infusion

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Joy

Once per day, a juvenile or older mythic havoc dragon can grant all creatures within the radius of its planar infusion a bonus against mind-affecting spells and effects equal to ½ its mythic rank. This effect lasts for 24 hours. In addition, the dragon is treated as if it possessed the same teamwork feats as creatures present in the area.

Bardic Performance

A young or older mythic havoc dragon can use bardic performance as a bard of its caster level.

Grappling Tail

A mythic havoc dragon’s tail can grab an opponent with a successful attack.

Lashing Tail (Ex)

A havoc dragon’s tail slap attack has reach equal to its bite attack and gains the trip special attack.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Elysium)
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Mythic havoc dragons are the enemies of all that could bring sadness and desperation to mortal creatures. They can abduct “sad” people to offer them a life of pleasure in their private realms.
